Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Yes, an address change can be requested, depending on whether your order has shipped or is still in production:
- If your order is still in production: Shipping addresses can be updated at no additional cost up until the order is prepared to ship.
- If your order has already shipped: We can submit an address change request with the carrier. There is a $20.00 carrier-assessed fee per package for FedEx Ground shipments (freight shipments require a custom quote). Depending on the delivery stage, a reroute may not always be possible; if the carrier is unable to update it before delivery, the ground fee is refunded.
